organisation.name: Southbridge Community Trust
organisation.mission: Employment support and skills training for adults in economic hardship
organisation.it_stack: Google Workspace; Salesforce nonprofit CRM; no dedicated IT team

interviews.quote_summary: Concerned about AI risk but recognises competitive pressure; wants a phased approach.
Beneficiary communication is the main pain point; case-note writing takes hours.
Manual invoice processing is the slowest task; would value document extraction.
Limited capacity; needs lightweight tooling that does not require maintenance.
Volunteer onboarding is repetitive paperwork; an AI assistant might help.
Reporting to funders is time-consuming and uses similar phrasing each time.
Reconciliation work is straightforward but slow; pattern-matching opportunity.
Wants assurance on consent, data protection, and trustee oversight before any rollout.
